power.headline: 2026 NFL Power Rankings: How all 32 teams stack up for Week 6

words.games.title: Ranked Games
words.games.lede: Every game played by a team in the {poll}, week by week.
words.games.lede_fbs: Every game played by an FBS team, week by week.
words.rankings.title: Top 25 Rankings
words.rankings.lede_goat: This site's own ranking of every FBS team. The top 25 are the same 25 teams as the AP poll, put in order by the poll itself (half the score), strength of schedule, strength of record and head to head; every other team follows from 26 the same way.
words.rankings.frozen: Final for the season: frozen at the end of the regular season.
words.rankings.lede_conf: Every conference, strongest first. Inside a conference, teams are in order of their record in conference games.
words.rankings.note: Record and change are from the poll, which is looked for on every update and normally comes out on Sunday afternoon. Choose a team to see its page.
words.rankings.note_goat: Beside each team is every team it has beaten and lost to this season, with their GOAT places (a team from outside FBS has none). The AP column is the team's place in the AP poll; a dash means it is not ranked there. Redone on every update.
words.rankings.note_other: Record and change are from the ranking itself. The numbers beside teams elsewhere on this site are from the AP poll.
words.rankings.note_conf: The seven teams above the line in each conference would make the playoffs.
words.teams.title: Top 25 Team Stats
words.teams.lede: How each ranked team scores, moves the ball and defends, per game, and what its opponents manage against it. From the box scores.
words.teams.lede_fbs: How every FBS team scores, moves the ball and defends, per game, and what its opponents manage against it. From the box scores.
words.teams.note: Yards, third downs, turnovers, penalties and points per drive count games with a box score. Rating is where this site's rating of results places the team among all FBS teams; SOS ranks the 25 by how strong their opponents have been. Choose a column heading to sort; hold or hover over a heading for what it means.
words.teams.note_fbs: Yards, third downs, turnovers, penalties and points per drive count games with a box score. Rating is where this site's rating of results places the team among all FBS teams; SOS ranks every team by how strong its opponents have been. Choose a column heading to sort; hold or hover over a heading for what it means.
words.team.players_note: # is his rank by Impact per game among all regulars on the 25 ranked teams; part-time players are greyed and not ranked. Choose a name for his card.
words.team.players_note_fbs: # is his rank by Impact per game among all regulars in FBS; part-time players are greyed and not ranked. Choose a name for his card.
words.players.title: Top Players
words.players.lede: Every regular on a ranked team, ranked against the rest by Impact per game: the points he adds per game over an average top-25 regular at his position.
words.players.lede_fbs: Every regular in FBS, ranked against the rest by Impact per game: the points he adds per game over an average FBS regular at his position.
words.players.note: Impact compares each player only with regulars at his position on this week's top 25 teams, from the box scores. It cannot see blocking, coverage or who was on the field, it does not adjust for the opponent, and offensive linemen have no numbers to rate. Quarterbacks touch the ball most, so they fill the top and the bottom of the list.
words.players.note_fbs: Impact compares each player with every regular at his position in FBS, from the box scores. It cannot see blocking, coverage or who was on the field, and it does not adjust for the opponent, so players on weaker schedules can rate higher here than in the Top 25 view. Offensive linemen have no numbers to rate.
words.players.career_note: Each season's line is ESPN's, with a line for every school he has played for. It is read again after each of his team's games, so this season's line can be a game behind.
words.players.career_wait: His earlier seasons have not been read yet. A few thousand players' careers are read on each update, the ranked teams' first, so they appear here within a day or two.
words.nfl.games_lede: Every NFL game, week by week: the betting line, where to watch, and the score as it happens.
words.nfl.rankings_lede: The NFL standings, through games of {date}.
words.nfl.rankings_lede_goat: This site's own ranking of the 32 teams: ESPN's newest power ranking (half the score), strength of schedule, strength of record and head to head.
words.nfl.rankings_note: Teams are placed by share of games won (a tie counts as half a win), then wins, then points scored less points allowed; the league's own tie-breakers are not worked through, so teams level on record can sit in a different order here. Records and points are the league's, from ESPN. Choose a team to see its page.
words.nfl.rankings_note_conf: Seeds are ESPN's, as things stand: the four division leaders first, then the best of the rest. The seven teams above the line in each conference would make the playoffs.
words.nfl.rankings_note_goat: Every team is ranked on four things: its place in ESPN's newest power ranking (50%; the standings, until there is one), strength of schedule (20%: how good the teams it has played are, on average), strength of record (20%: a win counts for more the better the team beaten, a loss costs more the weaker the team lost to), and head to head (10%: a team is ranked above one it has the better of when the two are that close on the rest).
words.nfl.teams_lede: How every NFL team scores, moves the ball and defends, per game, and what its opponents manage against it. From the box scores.
words.nfl.teams_note: Yards, third downs, turnovers, penalties and points per drive count games with a box score. Rating is where this site's rating of results places the team in the league; SOS ranks every team by how strong its opponents have been. Choose a column heading to sort; hold or hover over a heading for what it means.
words.nfl.team_players_note: # is his rank by Impact per game among all NFL regulars; part-time players are greyed and not ranked. Choose a name for his card.
words.nfl.players_lede: Every regular in the NFL, ranked against the rest by Impact per game: the points he adds per game over an average NFL regular at his position.
words.nfl.players_note: Impact compares each player with every regular at his position in the NFL, from the box scores. It cannot see blocking, coverage or who was on the field, it does not adjust for the opponent, and offensive linemen have no numbers to rate.
words.nfl.players_career_note: Each season's line is ESPN's, regular season only, with a line for every team he has played for. It is read again after each of his team's games, so this season's line can be a game behind.
words.nfl.players_career_wait: His earlier seasons have not been read yet. They appear here within a day.
words.games.odds_short: These percentages are this site's own estimate of each team's chance of winning, not betting lines.
